acceptanceCriteria: Each harvested block names its flow/screen binding or an explicit UNBOUND reason.
Binding uses the site-knowledge IR where available; a focused test covers both cases.
body: Residual from lane cce-1022k (PR beamfall/corvint#1546, seal 1aa0691af). Blocks proposed by the deterministic harvester (V1-1683, CCE-V0-041..044) are not bound to site-knowledge flows or screens, so compiled tests cannot be traced to the screen they exercise.
title: CCE harvested blocks carry no flow or screen binding
